name: NVIDIA Isaac Sim
fullName: NVIDIA Isaac Sim robotics simulation platform
summary: Robotics simulation platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse, with a USD-native scene representation, import of URDF, MJCF and CAD models, simulated sensors and a ROS bridge.

knowledge.rationale: A simulator executes models of robot behaviour and sensing.

version.label: Isaac Sim 6.x (documentation covers 6.0 and 6.1 migrations; Isaac Lab 3.0 targets 6.2)

license.name: Source code Apache-2.0; building and running it requires NVIDIA Omniverse components under NVIDIA terms

licenses.name: Apache License 2.0 (Isaac Sim source code)
licenses.reviewNote: As granted by the licence text; dependencies and third-party components not assessed. Not legal advice.

licenses.name: NVIDIA Omniverse licensing terms (Kit SDK and extensions, accepted at first build)
restrictions: Building or running Isaac Sim requires accepting the NVIDIA Omniverse licensing terms and downloading the Kit SDK and extensions.

limitations.text: Requires accepting NVIDIA Omniverse licensing terms for runtime components; Isaac Lab describes Isaac Sim as having its own proprietary terms.
The exact current release number is not stated on the documentation landing page.

engineeringUses: Testing robot perception and control software against simulated sensors before hardware is available
Generating synthetic sensor data for training perception models

verification.notes: Capabilities as described by the publisher; exact version to confirm.
